name: x8 Luck [STACKS]
description:
Permanently multiplies your roll Luck by 8

FORMULA:
Multiplies your Luck by 8. Stacks by multiplying with other luck boosts (x2 + x4 = x8).
How rolls work: each rarity's weight = Base x (Luck ^ Power). Your chance of a rarity = its weight / the sum of all rarity weights. Which unit you get inside a rarity is not changed.

name: x2 drops

Permanently doubles every item drop chance from defeated enemies

Doubles the drop chance of every item enemies drop: new chance = old chance x 2, up to a maximum of 100%.
Examples: 0.5% -> 1%, 1% -> 2%, 10% -> 20%, 50% -> 100%, 60% -> 100%.
Applies to item drops from enemies and Instant Clear rewards. Does not change unit rolls, gold or mutations.

description:
The big Aussie tourer, built for the long way round.

Unlocks the GU Patrol (Y61) wagon for good, on every trail in Low Range.

• 4.8 litre petrol straight six with the real truck's power, and engine sound from real recordings
• 37 inch mud tyres on black beadlocks, on a 4 inch lift
• Steel hoop bar with driving lights, a stainless snorkel and rock sliders
• Loaded roof rack: LED light bar, awning, high-lift jack and jerry cans
• Weighs what the real one does: heavy, torquey and planted

name: Dirty 30
description:
The famous chopped 60 Series, built to go anywhere and carry everything.

Unlocks the Dirty 30 for good, on every trail in Low Range.

• A 60 Series cut down to a single-cab ute, on an 80 Series chassis and axles
• Turbo diesel straight six
• 37 inch mud tyres on black beadlocks, on a 4 inch lift
• Coils all round with yellow springs and remote-reservoir shocks
• Front and rear air lockers for the hardest climbs
• Steel bar with a winch and twin driving lights, plus a moulded snorkel
• Alloy tray and canopy, with a rooftop tent and side awning on top
• Recovery boards, jerry cans and a tool box packed in beside the spare

Short, heavy and stiff. It loves a rock step, so pick your line and let it crawl.

name: 78 Troopy
description:
78 SERIES TROOPY

Already own the Supporter Edition? The Troopy is included, so you don't need to buy this pass.

The legendary Land Cruiser Troop Carrier, built for long-range touring across the outback.

- Turbo diesel with real engine recordings
- 4" lift on 37" mud tyres and silver steel wheels
- Steel bull bar with twin spotlights and a hidden winch
- Raised snorkel for deep water crossings
- Pop-top roof, side awning and recovery boards
- Rear bar with a swing-out spare and a jerry can carrier
- Rock sliders, wide flares and twin aerials
- Two fuel tanks for extra range

Long, heavy and built to go anywhere, slowly. Pick your line carefully, because it's a tall truck.

• 240+ realistic colours and shades
• Separate colours for the body, lower panels, roof and stripes (on trucks that have them)
• Gloss, Satin, Matte and Metallic finishes
• Gunmetal, Silver and White rims
• Save up to 3 designs per truck
• Your paint shows on every map, and other players see it too

Works on every truck you own. Anyone can try a look in the Workshop. Pro Paint lets you drive it.

- Straitjacket patients that exhibit volatile behavior! ⛓️‍💥
- Get access to more areas of the asylum with your Facility Director Keycard 💳
- Highest position on the player list to show your power 💼
- Use the facility wide voice-chat intercom to issue asylum-wide announcements 📢
- Use a Remote Console to open doors remotely to cause some chaos 💥

name: Auto Macro
description:
When enabled in settings, this feature automates the following actions:
- Auto Eating: Eats from your inventory when hunger drops below 30% (must have food).
- Auto XP Boost: Uses food that grants an XP boost.
- Auto Sleeping: Sleeps at 90% fatigue if near a bed (won’t sleep with Indomitable Will).
- Auto Equipment: Equips your best vests and weights.
- Auto Training: Trains continuously with the selected tool.
- Auto Logs: Automatically does Striking Logs, stops when below 10% health and switches to your previous training until you are back at 100% health.
- Persistence After Gripping: Keeps training after being gripped unless you lose your tools.
- Auto Rejoin: Rejoins every 18 minutes if AFK to keep the macro running. (? Server)
- Customizable Menu: A settings menu with various automation options.

(DOES NOT WORK WITH SHADOW BOXING)
You can store all your tools in your inventory, and the system will still work. Just activate training once, store the tool, and let it run!

The Mobile Task Forces are elite armed units meant to deal with incredible threats. They are the best of the best of the Foundation.

By purchasing this gamepass, you unlock access to the Nu-7, Beta-7, Epsilon-11 and Alpha-1 Mobile Task Forces and their upgraded variants.

Nu- 7 “Hammer Down”: They are a combat centered unit aimed at taking down hostile forces. (10% more damage to Chaos Insurgency)

Beta-7 “Maz Hatters”: They specialize in the containment of infectious SCPs such as SCP - 008. (25% more damage to infected)

Epsilon-11 “Nine-Tailed Fox”: They are a special ops force deployed to deal with dangerous SCP breaches. (50% faster containment)

Alpha-1 “Red Right Hand”: They report directly to the O5 Council, and assist them in situations that require utmost secrecy, on top of acting as their bodyguards. (20% faster reload)

The Chaos Insurgency was previously a loyal special task force working directly under the O5 Council. One day, they turned against the Foundation for an unexplained reason. They’ve kept on fighting the Foundation ever since.

By purchasing this gamepass, you unlock access to the Chaos Insurgency team and its upgraded variant. [5% damage absorption + 25% faster hack]

Internal Security Department agents are tasked with keeping an eye on Foundation personnel, ensuring that no traitors are among its ranks and dealing with operational and information security risks.

By purchasing this gamepass, you unlock access to the Internal Security Department team and its upgraded variant and receive a Spas - 12.
Internal Security agents are able to detect rogue personnel from far away [250 STUDS] and mark hostiles on cameras [100 STUDS].

name: Permanent H.T.C Entry
description:
You can take your training up a notch by entering the Hyperbolic Time Chamber. In here, you can earn more skill points, improve your stats, and gain EXP by using the training mode inside the chamber. The training mode is where you can work on the stat category you want to improve in. You can also enter with others and master your transformations quicker by fighting others inside the chamber.

To access the Time Chamber, you fly to Kami's Lookout. Walk towards the door entrance and click it to enter. 

- You earn skill points by doing the Training Mode in the chamber.
- You also gain slight EXP from doing the Training Mode (Every 100 Levels, it gets more rewarding).
- Form Mastery is more effective inside the chamber when fighting others.
- Stay inside for 2 hours worth of training.
- Bumps your max amount of stats gainable to 50 per day.

NOTE -
You can enter the Time Chamber for in-game currency (Zeni). This pass allows you to enter without Zeni.

name: Gravity Chamber Entry
description:
In here, you can train with the training bots to gain quicker EXP at a much faster rate. Inside the room, enter the training zone around the training bots to start your training. The main goal is to defeat as many bots as you can while they shoot laser beams at you. To access the Gravity Room, you fly to Capsule Corp in West City. You will see a spaceship sitting there. You click it to enter. 

- Safe Zone (Bots are deactivated and won't attack you) [EXP Unearnable]
- Training Zone (Bots activate and will attack you) [EXP Earnable]
- You can bump up for an incredibly high boost in EXP!
- Stay inside for 2 hours worth of training.
- Bumps your max amount of stats gainable to 20 per day.

Note -
The Gravity Chamber can be entered in game for in game currency. This pass allows you to enter for free and for increased amount of time.

Next, the "Smoke Bomb" gadget can be deployed to cause damage on impact, and temporarily confuse your enemies into firing into the smoke, so long as you're out of their sight. The "Subspace Tripmine" gadget is a deployable mine that, after a few seconds, becomes armed and deals massive damage in the area around it. Finally, the "Dynamite" gadget shows your mastery of gunpowder, causing a huge explosion a short time after the fuse is lit. Think of it as a bigger grenade.

name: Bloxian Foreign Oversight
description:
West Noobia's primary foreign ally, The Commonwealth of Bloxia, has provided Military Aid in the form of APCs, IFVs, and military advisors. Bloxia is far beyond the Noobic Continent in forms of weaponry and technology. The Bloxian Foreign Oversight is the powerhouse of the raider team, being able to shift the tide of ANY battle.

As a Bloxian Foreign Advisor, you will get the following:

- Heavy APC
- Heavy APC with mounted Anti-Armor rifle (Cooldown)
- Bradley IFV (Cooldown)
- M80 Sniper Rifle (Crouch and stay still for the best shots.)
- Ellan L1 Reloadable AT 
- BR-18A2

This team may only be joined if there are 15+ defense personnel online, (Military, Plant Security, Military Police)

All cooldowns are SHARED. Cooldowns for all bloxian items will be determined by the amount of security and military online. (More = Less)

As a Cavalry Scout of the regiment, you'll have:

- Access to light tanks and IFVs! - Cooldowns for spawning
- A special reconnaissance jeep.
- The exclusive Jericho SMG!
- SUPER COOL CAVALRY STETSONS!

**NOTE**
- The RCV-1 has a 10 minute cooldown on spawning.
- The VT-1 has a 20 minute cooldown on spawning.
- You are unable to become cavalry if there aren't 8 or more raiders.

name: Special Operations
description:
The elite of the Ground Service Special Operations Command, Special Forces commandos serve as the tip of the spear of the Stratocracy's Army. Specialised in direct action and unconventional warfare, they come equipped with a variety of suppressed firearms, AT vehicles, and Gatling gun-mounted LSUVs. 

As a Special Forces commando, you receive:

- Exclusive Blackout Uniform
- D-23 Spectre & Munzworf Shotgun
- Jeep with Recoilless Rifle
- Minigun LSUV
- Suppressed M19

name: Federal Rangers Regiment
description:
The rangers of West Noobia are skilled in solo/small group infiltration. With better equipment and camera scan invisibility, you'll easily be able to sneak around the plant to complete your mission.

What you'll get:

- Silenced Weston SMG, a more modern and quieter gun.
- Camera Scan invisibility
- Black ranger uniform
- Captured facility vehicles to sneak in

You are unable to become a raider if there aren't enough defenders.

The Marines of West Noobia specialize in providing an edge with better equipped APCs that completely protect the gunner and occupants. Absolutely necessary for assaults.

- Blue Marine uniforms

You are unable to become a raider if there isn't enough defenders.

name: Local Military Police
description:
A subsidiary of the Interior Service, the Local Military Police act as the "Sheriffs" of the Naramo District while the federals preside over them. They are able to arrest people who are wanted, although lacking a lot of the technology and equipment the Federal-Level Military Police get.

As an LMP, you will get the following:

- Arrest tool
- Access to "Local Interior Service Personnel" team
- Ability to arrest and chase individuals who are wanted.
- Police Sedan
- Sheriff Cruiser
- Taser (Use against players who are not wanted results in punishment)
- Potential for being included in Federal Police events if you are lucky enough to be in the same server as one.

TO ARREST:

- Bring them to the Prison Sector gate and press Q on the prompt.
- Bring them to any MP car and hold Q on the driver side door.
- Only works on MP, Police, or Sheriff vehicles.

**Handcuff tool functions as a Z card**

As "Plant Director" you are responsible for the following:

- Locking down the plant when necessary

This is an ADMINISTRATIVE team. You will also get the following abilities:

name: Custom Audio
description:
With this gamepass, you will be able to set the stage music to anything you like! (Does not require you to be a manager character)

HOW TO USE:

1. Enter the game with the gamepass.

2. Find the "Custom Audio" machine in the back room and click the yellow button.

3. Find an audio by going to the "develop" page on the website, going into "library", and finding one you would like.

4. Copy the string of numbers in the URL.  

5. Paste it into the white box area of the custom audio menu.

6. Click the "OK" button.

7. You should be good to go!

name: Custom Image
description:
With this gamepass, you will be able to change your character image to anything you want!

HOW TO USE:

1. Enter the game with the gamepass.

2. Click the button at the top right to open the image menu.

3. Find a decal by going to the "develop" page on the website, going into "library", and finding one you would like.

4. Copy the string of numbers in the URL.

5. Paste it into the "Image ID" area of the custom image menu.

6. If the decal doesn't show up, subtract one from it. (i.e 12345678 > 12345677)

7. It should be good to go!

name: The Night Lake - Night Fishing Pack
description:
Unlock the Night Fishing Pack forever!

The Night Lake: a long, narrow lake where the biggest fish in the game live. Day turns into night, and the big ones come out after dark.

Your own bivvy and bedchair on every swim
Rest in your bivvy: your bite alarms wake you when a fish takes, then run out and strike
Day and night: 4 minutes of day, 5 minutes of night, with a real morning and evening
The biggest fish in the game: carp up to 40 kg, catfish over 60 kg, sturgeon over 55 kg
Its own legendary monsters: The Moonlight Queen, The Dark Whisker, Moon Ghost and more
6 swims: cast across the lake to the wooded far bank

Night fishing needs a rod pod (Rod Pod or Rod Pod Plus): its bite alarms are what wake you up.

name: Rodpod Plus
description: Take your carp fishing setup to the next level with the Rod Pod Plus. Fish with two rods at the same time and enjoy premium bite alarms that alert you whenever a fish takes your bait. With its sturdy design and professional look, it's a must-have for every serious carp angler!

name: Second Rod

name: Rod Pod

name: Elite Gold Carp Rod
description:
The best rod in the game. Black carbon with cork grips, a gold big pit reel with a walnut knob, spooled with lavender line.

Casts 15% further
Reels your fish in 40% faster
Softer tension spikes in the fight
Yours forever, on every lake

Equip it in Equipment > Rods.

name: Pro Carp Rod
description:
The Pro Carp Rod is built for serious carp anglers. With a sleek black design, a strong rod blank and a premium finish, it's ready to take on powerful fish.

Perfect for long sessions and hard-fighting carp. Get ready for your next big catch!

name: The Duo Isles
description:
Unlock The Duo Isles forever!

A wide island lake made for fishing together. Every island has room for two anglers. Bring a friend or team up with anyone on the server.

4 duo islands with 2 fishing spots each, side by side.

Fast action: expect a bite about every minute.

Carp from 5 to 33 kg, plus heavy catfish and sturgeon.

Strong fish that put a real bend in your rod.

Discover its legendary monsters: Old Isle Annie, The Polder Kraken, Grey Armour and more.

Explore lily fields, reed beds and islands full of fishing opportunities.

Grab a buddy, pick an island and see who catches the biggest fish!

name: The Twin Basins
description:
Unlock The Twin Basins forever!

A quiet golden-hour lake with a small and a large basin, separated by a wooded peninsula. This is where the giants live.

Only big fish: every fish weighs over 10 kg.

Carp up to 35 kg, catfish and sturgeon over 50 kg.

Brutal fights: these fish fight harder and longer than anywhere else.

Meet its legendary monsters: The Twin Queen, The Basin Beast, Basin Leviathan and more.

6 fishing spots around the lake.

Bites are rare, so every run counts. Patience pays off here. Are you the one who will catch The Twin Queen?

name: Big Pit 14000 + Yellow Line
description:
A 12ft carp rod with a big 14000 pit reel and hi-vis yellow line - built for long range.

Casts 8% further
Reels your fish in 20% faster
Yours forever, on every lake

Equip it in Equipment > Rods.

name: The Surface Pond
description:
Unlock the Surface Fishing Pond forever!

Experience a completely different style of carp fishing! This special pond is designed exclusively for surface fishing. Cast your floating bait, watch the fish rise to the surface and wait for the perfect moment to strike.

name: Carp Cradle
description:
A padded carp cradle on legs. Every fish you land lies safe, raised off the ground - the way the pros handle big carp.

Looks only: it doesn't change your fishing
Replaces your unhooking mat on every swim and every lake
Switch back to your standard mat any time in Equipment

Yours forever.

name: The Valley River – Wild River Fishing
description:
Unlock The Valley River forever!

A wide turquoise river flowing through a green valley between steep mountains. No swims here: walk the bank, pick your spot and set up wherever you like.

Real flowing water: the current pulls on every fish you hook
Only big fish: carp and catfish from 10 to 36 kg - and the catfish are hungry
Over 100 fish, every one with its own name: they grow, heal, fall ill and one day they die
Its own legendary monsters: Old Ironside, The Gorge Wels, Big Bend Betty and more
Rare fish that each live at their own spot: koi under the willows, two giant sturgeon over 60 kg on a hard bottom mid-river, and The River King and Queen by the dead wood
With the best rod you just reach the far bank
At most 6 anglers per server

Slow, realistic bites: read the current, feed your spot and wait for the big one. Night fishing with the Night Fishing Pack.

name: Camo Bivvy
description:
A camo bivvy with a rolled-up door and a canopy, with your bedchair inside. It's set up behind your swim when you fish at night.

Looks only: it doesn't change your fishing
Shows on the night lakes (Night Fishing Pack)
Switch back to your green bivvy any time in Equipment

Yours forever.

name: Bait Lab Pass
description:
Roll your own boilies - for FREE, forever!

Unlock the Bait Lab and make every boilie without paying a single coin. Pick your mix, your flavour, your colour and the finish (boilie, pop-up or wafter, size and booster) as often as you like.

- 6 mixes, 14 flavours and 9 colours
- Up to +20% bites and up to +7% coins per fish
- The right flavour pulls more mirrors or more commons
- Use your boilies on your rig, as a pop-up, as a snowman or in your throwing stick

Without the pass you unlock the lab for 2,000 coins and pay for every boilie you roll.

name: Buzzer Bars
description:
Get the Buzzer Bars straight away and keep them forever!

Stainless banksticks with two bite alarms and swingers - pushed into the ground on the bank, or on a ground plate on a jetty. Hear every run with their own real bite alarm sound and watch the LEDs and swingers move on every take.

- +6% bites
- +0.5 seconds to strike
- Counts as a rod pod: fish with a second rod, at The Night Lake and on The Valley River

You can also buy them in the shop for 3,500 coins.

name: 2x Chance To Play As Thomas
description:
Doubles your selection weight when choosing the Monster!

How It Works:
- Normal selection weight: 1x
- With gamepass: 2x
- Example (4 players, only you own the pass):
  - Before: 25% chance
  - After: 40% chance
  - Other players: 20% each

Chances are calculated using each player's weight divided by the total lobby weight. All players' chances combined always equal 100%.

Actual odds depend on lobby size and how many players own the pass. Selection is not guaranteed.
